installation.description: The layout v5 installation written to.

from.description: The layout v4 installation read from.

phase.description: started: kept before the first write; completed: kept after the last one.

overwrite.description: True when the run may replace a destination value that differs from the source's.

written.description: How many items the run writes (started) or wrote (completed), new and replaced.

replaced.description: How many of those replace a destination value that differed.

replaced_names.description: The destination items an overwrite replaces, as module and name. Names only, never a value.
